images.name: commercial-hero
images.prompt:
A wide view across an open-plan commercial office floor where water has spread from a failed riser in the corner. Low-pile carpet tiles are dark and saturated across a wide area with several tiles lifted and stacked on end against a desk pedestal, exposing damp screed beneath. Water has tracked along the skirting trunking and under a glazed partition into the next bay. Workstations, monitors and chairs are still in place, pushed aside at odd angles, and a few cardboard document boxes sit lifted onto a desktop clear of the floor.

HERO COMPOSITION — this sits behind a page headline. The LEFT 40% of the frame must stay visually quiet: an empty stretch of wall, floor or an unremarkable corner, with no subject, no strong edges and no bright area. Put the damage in the RIGHT half. Keep the overall tone mid-to-dark — a navy wash is laid over the left side and white text sits on top of it. Wide shot of the whole space, not a close-up. Leave headroom above. 16:9 landscape, 1600x900.

Shot by a restoration technician on a mid-range phone on arrival — a working record, not a photograph anyone meant to be seen.
No people. No hands. No technicians. The space is empty — this is the problem before anyone started work.
LIGHT: whatever was already in the room. An overhead fixture, grey daylight, or a work light. Mixed colour temperature is fine. No sun shafts, no golden hour, no backlighting, no bright highlights, no blown-out areas.
SURFACES: everything has history. Carpet shows traffic lanes and uneven pile. Paint has roller texture and patched spots that do not match. Baseboards are chipped with old caulk lines. Walls have nail holes and faint marks. Floors are not level. Nothing repeats cleanly across the frame.
CAMERA: handheld at chest height, slightly off-level. Imperfect framing with something clipped at an edge. Natural phone depth of field, most of the frame in focus. Visible sensor noise in darker areas. Flat, slightly muted colour as a phone JPEG renders it, not graded.
DO NOT PRODUCE: glossy or mirror-finish floors; uniform carpet that looks like a tiled texture; evenly lit rooms with no shadow falloff; staged or symmetrical composition; a room that looks recently renovated; saturated or teal-and-orange colour; shallow depth of field with blurred background; lens flare; bokeh; visible brand logos; readable text; any person or body part; HDR-looking shadow lift.
If it looks like a product shot or a stock photo, it is wrong. It should look like evidence.
Slightly underexposed, taken in a hurry. Water reflections are dull, faint, broken and indistinct, never bright white or blue streaks. Keep light sources outside the frame. Do not bake in headline text or navy overlays.

images.name: reconstruction-hero
